test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Diseases.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given words:
 
 
• **Illness **and** sickness **are something that needs to be managed such as feelings of pain, discomfort, distress, weakness, fatigue, etc. (Illness and sickness ऐसी चीज है जिसे प्रबंधित करने की आवश्यकता होती है जैसे दर्द, बेचैनी, परेशानी, कमजोरी, थकान आदि की भावनाएं।)
 
• **Disease** is something that needs to be cured. (Disease एक ऐसी चीज है जिसे ठीक करने की जरूरत है।)
 
• **Ailment **is an illness, typically a minor one. (**Ailment** एक बीमारी है, आमतौर पर एक छोटी सी।)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Diseases.'
 
• The correct phrase: *......... **whole countries of such killing ***diseases*** as Typhus and the Plague.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The meaning of the word 'transplant' is to take (living tissue or an organ) and implant it in another part of the body or in another body.

 
 
• Example: *A kidney was transplanted from one identical twin to another.*
 
 

4c:T10e0,

The correct answer is 'Diseases.'
